quote_json: "For a multi-dimensional array, the array initializer must have as many levels of nesting as there are dimensions in the array."
notes: A diagnostic (reject) at ISO-1 for `int[,,] cells = {};`, `static byte[,,] cells = { {}, {}, {} };` and `new long[,,,] {}`; the full-depth controls compile and print OK 0. Existing tests that rely on the zero-length assumption belong to the later level. At ISO-2, ECMA-334 4th ed 19.7, p. 340 (PDF p. 362) requires this result. Each source lacks the required nesting depth in an empty multidimensional initializer. The fourth rule states the full-depth requirement without an empty-initializer exception.
